question.body:
Let $f$ and $g$ be the functions defined by $f(x)= frac(1,x)$ and $g(x)= frac(4 x,1 + 4 x^(2))$, for all $x > 0$.

(a) Find the absolute maximum value of $g$ on the open interval $(0 \, oo)$ if the maximum exists. Find the absolute minimum value of $g$ on the open interval $(0 \, oo)$ if the minimum exists. Justify your answers.

(b) Find the area of the unbounded region in the first quadrant to the right of the vertical line $x = 1$, below the graph of $f$, and above the graph of $g$.
